crew.overview: 16-year old Rhiannon falls in love with a mysterious spirit named “A” that inhabits a different body every day. Feeling an unmatched connection, Rhiannon and “A” work each day to find each other, not knowing what the next day will bring.
crew.title: Every Day

details.biography: Marina Brackenbury is an entertainment executive and the current head of film and television for Scott Free UK. Brackenbury previously worked at HanWay Films, New Line Cinema, Picturehouse, Stink, Shine Pictures, and FilmWave before joining Scott Free UK in 2019.
details.name: Marina Brackenbury
